purpose: One bounded read-only recovery check after the failed 16:42 pre/post probes; no target execution or calibration
recovery_acceptance: Every one of the ten intervals must pass both unchanged criteria. The original controller must then independently pass its own pre-batch check and the original formal resource gates before resuming.
failure_action: Do not resume the campaign. Preserve its user_paused checkpoint, all failed and passed probes, and a clock-blocked explanation. No repeated probing until a lucky pass.
